name: deploy-production

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact certified Git SHA to deploy
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [production-release]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    environment: production
    env:
      EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: team_zmEezpOKGZy2sH5nqTfO44LD
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: prj_OfVZG87ItRr7Kzw6PJT9Z5ouw04K
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Refuse a different SHA
        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
      - name: Require production-release push to match current main
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          git fetch origin main --depth=1
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
      - name: Require Vercel deployment credential
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${VERCEL_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Actions secret VERCEL_TOKEN. Add a Vercel access token with deployment access to the provenance-cleaner project."
            exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm i -g vercel@59.10.0
      - name: Pull Production configuration
        run: vercel env pull .env.local --yes --environment=production --token="${VERCEL_TOKEN}" --scope="${VERCEL_ORG_ID}"
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      - name: Production configuration preflight
        run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/predeploy.mjs
      - name: Production release gate
        run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/release-gate.mjs
      - name: Ensure Stripe TEST Billing Portal
        run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/configure-stripe-portal.mjs
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: Re-run Production preflight immediately before build
        run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/predeploy.mjs
      - name: Build exact Production artifact
        run: vercel build --prod --token="${VERCEL_TOKEN}" --scope="${VERCEL_ORG_ID}"
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      - name: Deploy exact prebuilt Production artifact
        id: deploy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$(vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --yes --token="${VERCEL_TOKEN}" --scope="${VERCEL_ORG_ID}")"
          printf '%s\n' "$output"
          deployment_url="$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -Eo 'https://[^[:space:]]+\.vercel\.app' | tail -n 1)"
          test -n "$deployment_url"
          echo "url=$deployment_url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      - name: Verify deployed SHA and public readiness
        env:
          DEPLOYMENT_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
        run: node scripts/verify-production.mjs --url "$DEPLOYMENT_URL" --expected-sha "$EXPECTED_SHA" --attempts 12 --delay-ms 5000

# Implementation Roadmap

## Phase 0 — deterministic text scanner ✅
Exact Unicode detection, conservative cleaning, receipts and regression tests.

## Phase 1 — file provenance and metadata hygiene ✅
Local inspection plus safe sanitation for supported image/DOCX formats, provenance guardrails and post-clean verification. PDF remains inspection-only by product policy.

## Phase 2 — verified provenance ✅
Official C2PA browser verification, SHA-256 receipts, structured validation states and signed-provenance mutation blocking.

## Phase 3 — semantic transformation ✅
Protected spans, chunking, AI Gateway editing, factual invariants, bounded retries, receipts and stale-request protection.

## Phase 4 — accounts and atomic credits ✅
Supabase anonymous/registered auth, append-only FIFO ledger, reservations, one-time Stripe TEST Checkout/webhooks and authoritative spend economics.

## Phase 5 — production hardening ✅
Turnstile, rate limits, request IDs, privacy-safe logs, reconciliation, security headers, health/readiness, Playwright and CI.

## Phase 6 — privacy/accounting parity ✅
FIFO purchase lots, signup/guest promo controls, refund accounting, privacy-safe job history and controlled deletion reconciliation.

## Phase 7 — Admin, FinOps and subscriptions ✅
Private RBAC, operational rollups, cost evidence, Stripe TEST subscriptions, invoice-authoritative monthly grants and Billing Portal.

## Phase 8 — release hardening ✅ source / runtime certification in progress
Readiness contracts, deletion safety, Stripe reconciliation hardening, Admin owner bootstrap, TEST revenue/MRR evidence and exact-SHA deployment controls.

## Phase 9A — production release integrity ✅ source / promotion externally gated
Reusable exact-SHA production verification, scheduled/main-push drift detection, and deployment-workflow verification against canonical health and readiness. Production promotion remains externally gated by the GitHub Actions `VERCEL_TOKEN` credential.

## Phase 9B — developer API and automation 🚧
Verified-account API keys with hashed-secret storage, immediate revocation, machine-to-machine deterministic scan, authoritative usage balance, billable semantic transform, a zero-dependency Node CLI, and database-backed Phase 9 developer readiness evidence. Team workspaces remain a separate later wave so API identity and economic boundaries can be certified first.

## Release certification
A release is complete only after the final branch is merged, the corresponding database migration is applied and verified, security/readiness checks pass, live Preview smoke is green, and the exact final `main` SHA is deployed and verified in Production.

  pull_request:

concurrency:

  cancel-in-progress: true

  contents: read

jobs:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Controlled-launch static gate

        env:

      - name: Require committed lockfile
        run: test -f package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

# Provenance Cleaner Safe Editor — Chrome

This Manifest V3 extension provides in-place protected rewriting for selected text.

## What it does

- Uses the same `/api/v1/transform` endpoint as other developer clients.
- Supports mode, purpose, and rewrite intensity.
- Replaces selected text in `input`, `textarea`, and `contenteditable` surfaces.
- Keeps a single in-memory undo record for the last page edit.
- Shows a copyable result for read-only selections.
- Stores only the developer API key, API base URL, and preferences in `chrome.storage.local`.
- Does **not** store selected source text or generated output.

## Local installation

1. Open `chrome://extensions`.
2. Enable Developer mode.
3. Choose **Load unpacked** and select `extension/chrome`.
4. Create a developer API key from the Provenance Cleaner Account page.
5. Paste that key into the extension popup and save settings.

The production host permission is limited to `https://provenance-cleaner.vercel.app/*`; localhost is also allowed for development.

# FinOps

Costs use integer micros and money uses integer cents. Every provider cost event declares one source: `ACTUAL`, `ESTIMATED`, `MANUAL`, or `CONFIRMED_ZERO`.

The current provider inventory is Vercel, Supabase, Stripe, AI Gateway/model providers, Cloudflare Turnstile, GitHub Actions, and C2PA dependencies. A provider counts toward coverage only after its cost source is recorded. The Admin FinOps view deliberately shows zero coverage before cost rates or events exist rather than inventing an invoice.

Budgets are monthly micros with warning and critical thresholds. Forecasts use a clearly labelled run-rate calculation.
